components: Latency, errors, queue depth, and saturation describe current health.
A smoothed feedback rule computes a safer admission target.
Rate or concurrency capacity adjusts gradually toward the target.
Health recovers as admitted work falls below overload.
Capacity increases cautiously to avoid oscillation.
